about_the_game:
"Runemancer:Final 21 Days" is a unique rogue-like game. As a runemancer, players can harness the power of stone slabs to traverse between reality and dreams. Influence dreams through rune divination to grow stronger continuously, defeat monsters invading reality within 21 days, and save the world!

--------------------------------------

  • As the one chosen by the "Dream Ouija", you can traverse between reality and dreams with stone slabs.

  • Connect orbs on the "Dream Ouija" to form specific circuits, unleashing powerful skills or restricting your opponent's abilities.

  • Every move you make is critical—carefully decide whether to strengthen yourself or disrupt your foe.

  • You may freely adjust your skills before battle, and choose how to empower yourself during non-combat moments.

  • Adorable protagonist!

  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: OSX 10.14+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
